3. Past Half Yearly, Same mechanics as above but a 6-month lookback.
4. Based on Season, all seasons of particular buyer (which we show at the time of Main OC creation) will visible here and ratio will applicable based on the same.

candidates.text:
Auto populate Size Ratio (Ratio Allocation):
1. At the time of sales order creation through EDI system will allow the user to select the ‘Size Group’ at delivery level.
2. Size group will be a dropdown, multi-select per row & Only show Active Size Groups.
3. ‘Size group’ column visibility will be handled by EDI sales order package mapping screen (Visibility, Editable, Mandatory).
4. Size group & Ratio Allocation functionality will be enabled based on ‘Package Mapping’ and as agreed with implementation team we will enable it for those packages where Size come as ‘TBA’ & always size group/Ratio will replace the actual qty (color/size wise) coming in Excel/XML/Json file.
5. In case of ‘Size Group’ & ‘Ratio Allocation’, a copy below option is required to copy below & copy to all.
6. Each detail needs to be tracked under ‘OC creation/OC revision’ transactions screens, if user select the ‘Ratio allocation’ at the time of ‘Confirm’ system will pick the logic, if someone try to revise the oc by UI/EDI system will not change the ratio.
7. If after that sales order package (‘TBA’ qty package) buyer shared the correct Color/size wise qty details in that case or that ‘EDI package’ system will simply revise/Split the same size wise qty with actual buyer qty.
8. Split will be handled based on ‘Color grouped qty’ if at the time of sales order revision split qt is greater than the previous added size qty system will apply the proportionate logic.
